summary: Our project is an interactive video game about space missions, created using Genially. Players make decisions by clicking different buttons and links, which lead them through an original and entertaining story. The game addresses the challenge by showing how important decision-making is during a space mission, where every choice can have different consequences. It also demonstrates that even with simple tools, it is possible to create something creative and impressive. This project is important because it combines learning and entertainment, allowing players to experience some of the challenges of planning a space mission while having fun. It is free, easy to access, and can be played by anyone with the link.
details:
It works through different buttons with links that allow users to make decisions. Its benefits are that it is free, easy to view and use, entertaining, and very fun.

The expected impact is to make the experience fun while also teaching that it is possible to create something impressive using a very simple program. Another goal is to give users a taste of the decisions that need to be made during a space mission.

To create this project, we used Genially, a platform designed for creating presentations that can also be used to develop interactive games like ours.

What makes our project creative is that Genially is a very simple platform that is not commonly used to create and develop video games. In addition, our game has an original story created by us, which is also very funny.

We considered several factors, such as making the game accessible to everyone through a simple link, keeping it free and globally available, making it fun, creating at least a little adrenaline through decision-making, allowing players to relate to the characters, and ensuring that every decision leads to an ending.
